Current Projects

Unobtrusive Clinical Decision Support Tools — active research at Teesside University

EPSRC NortHFutures
01

Frailty Virtual Wards

Remote monitoring and AI clinical support for patients at home. Using wearable biosensors to continuously track physiological state, enabling proactive intervention without hospital admission.

Academy of Medical Sciences · Visiba Ltd
02

AI Triage Models

Integrating multimodal physiological and contextual data — including symptom details, demographics, remote vitals and patient history — to output care navigation, urgency scoring and diagnosis support in live NHS settings.

NIHR Team Science
03

Community Integration post Hip Fracture

Examining social and community integration measures as part of hip fracture recovery, moving beyond clinical outcomes to capture what matters most to patients during rehabilitation and return to daily life.

Teesside University
04

COPD Balance

Investigating balance recovery mechanisms and interventions for people living with COPD. Using musculoskeletal simulation and wearable sensor data to characterise postural control deficits and identify effective therapeutic targets.
